notes: Three-burner LP gas grill rated 36,000 BTU/hr; the propane cylinder is not included when sold. The parts list uses 104-series numbers (two rows print 105), and the igniter takes one AA battery that came with the grill.

gaps: Propane and gas_cylinder absent claims dropped: the manual saying the cylinder is not included describes the box, not a grill found in the field.
Parts list rows 1 and 2 print the prefix 105 (105-04006 bottom panel, 105-04018 caster); the other rows use 104. Shown as printed. The caster claim uses the printed 105-04018.

Parts list row 24 (104-03001) is a firebox assembly that includes the burners, valve and manifold, regulator and hose, control panel and igniter wire, and row 35 (104-13004) is another firebox assembly with lid bumpers. Neither is claimed as a set of parts.
The 36,000 BTU/hr rating (PDF p.25) is for the whole grill; no per-burner rating is claimed.
Material is not claimed for the heat tents, grease pan and cart panels. Filing the main burner as tube_frame and the casters as bearing is the researcher's classification; each spec names the part.
The main burner is sold as a pack of one (104-13011); the count of three comes from the cover, '3-BURNER LP GAS GRILL' (PDF p.2).
The manual's own cover reads DGB390SNP-D; the retailer's added front page names DGB390SNP-D-1.
Page numbers are PDF pages; the printed page is one less because the retailer added a front page.
method: Dyna-Glo owner's manual, GHP Group form 70-10-016, Rev 09/06/13, 82 pages, PDF hosted by Appliance Factory Parts (its front page is added; the rest carries the maker's form number, revision and contacts). Read as text; parts list (PDF pp.27-28) checked on rendered pages.
No manufacturer-hosted English copy was found; this is the parts retailer's copy.

comps.spec: Electronic ignition housing 104-13007, ignition electrode and ignition wire assembly 104-13012, and heat shield for electronic ignition 104-13013 (parts list); runs on one AA alkaline battery (PDF p.23, printed p.22)
LP gas hose and regulator assembly 104-13014 (parts list); the manual says to use only the regulator and hose assembly provided (PDF p.15, printed p.14)
LP gas valve and manifold 104-13006 (parts list)
Cooking grate 104-13002 (sold as a pack of 1; the package contents list two grates, PDF p.6, printed p.5). The manual calls the grates porcelain with an enamel finish (PDF p.19, printed p.18)
Temperature gauge with nut, part 104-12005 (parts list)
Main burner with cotter pin, part 104-13011 (sold as a pack of 1); three burners on the 3-burner grill. The warranty page gives the stainless steel burners 5 years (PDF p.25, printed p.24)
Heat tent, part 104-13003 (sold as a pack of 1); the package contents list three heat tents (PDF p.6, printed p.5)
Grease pan with heat shield, part 104-04013
Cart panels, one each: left side panel 104-04009, right side panel 104-04010, rear panel 104-04008
Casters: two casters printed as 105-04018, one swivel caster 104-04017 and one locking swivel caster 104-04019 (each listing includes screws and washers)
AA battery (1.5 V), part 104-05002, for the electronic igniter; the manual says one AA alkaline battery is included (PDF p.23, printed p.22)

sources.title: Dyna-Glo DGB390SNP-D Owner's Manual, 3-Burner LP Gas Grill, GHP Group form 70-10-016, Rev 09/06/13 (PDF hosted by Appliance Factory Parts; replacement parts list on PDF pages 27 and 28)
